title: worker_threads
statement: Which statements about the worker_threads module in Node.js 22 are true? Pick every one that applies.
choices: Each Worker runs its own V8 isolate with its own event loop, so a CPU-bound loop inside a worker does not block the main thread's event loop.
An object sent with worker.postMessage(obj) is shared by reference, so changes the worker makes to it are visible in the main thread.
A SharedArrayBuffer passed to a worker is shared without copying, and Atomics can be used to synchronise access to it.
Workers share the main thread's global variables and require() cache, so a module loaded in the main thread is not evaluated again in a worker.
